title: rhodiola amabilis
intro: Rhodiola amabilis, commonly known as Golden Root or Pink Root, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rhodiola genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving cognitive function, and enhancing physical performance. The therapeutic actions of Rhodiola amabilis include adaptogenic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Rhodiola amabilis include rosavin, salidroside, and tyrosol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often extracted and used in supplement form.
